title: Account Opening Review
description: Standard approval workflow for new account opening applications.

stages.title: Intake
stages.description: Verify submission completeness and required evidence.

stages.title: Cryptographic Validation
stages.description: Validate verifiable credential signatures and integrity.

stages.title: Approval
stages.description: Approve the application and dispatch the result to the wallet app.

evidenceRequirements.title: Identity document
evidenceRequirements.description: Government-issued identity proof must be present.

evidenceRequirements.title: Address verification
evidenceRequirements.description: Proof of residential or business address.

evidenceRequirements.title: Verifiable credential proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Cryptographic verification evidence from the wallet app.

title: KYC Refresh Review
description: Periodic refresh workflow for existing customers.

stages.title: Screening
stages.description: Run sanctions and risk re-screening.

stages.title: Credential Validation
stages.description: Validate the supplied verifiable credential.

stages.title: Reviewer Approval
stages.description: Reviewer signs off and sends update to wallet.

evidenceRequirements.title: Refresh evidence
evidenceRequirements.description: Current compliance refresh evidence and declarations.

evidenceRequirements.title: Verifiable credential proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Valid credential proof from the applicant wallet.

title: Enhanced Due Diligence Review
description: Escalated review workflow for high-risk cases.

stages.title: Triage
stages.description: Assess risk and identify mandatory checks.

stages.title: Cryptographic Validation
stages.description: Validate all verifiable credentials and proofs.

stages.title: Committee Approval
stages.description: Obtain committee approval before wallet dispatch.

evidenceRequirements.title: EDD pack
evidenceRequirements.description: Escalation memo and enhanced due diligence pack.

evidenceRequirements.title: Verifiable credential proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Proof of credential validity and integrity.

title: Development Finance Review
description: Approval workflow for development finance applications.

stages.title: Intake
stages.description: Check mandated documents and policy alignment.

stages.title: Technical Assessment
stages.description: Assess project viability, impact, and funding structure.

stages.title: Committee Approval
stages.description: Committee reviews and approves the financing proposal.

stages.title: Wallet Dispatch
stages.description: Approved outcome is sent to the wallet app.

evidenceRequirements.title: Project plan
evidenceRequirements.description: Detailed project plan and funding use case.

evidenceRequirements.title: Impact note
evidenceRequirements.description: Expected economic and social impact statement.

evidenceRequirements.title: Verifiable credential proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Cryptographic proof from the applicant wallet.

title: Citizen Empowerment Funds Review
description: Approval workflow for citizen empowerment and beneficiary funding.

stages.title: Intake
stages.description: Verify eligibility and completeness of the request.

stages.title: Eligibility Verification
stages.description: Confirm citizen identity and program eligibility.

stages.title: Approval
stages.description: Approve the funding request and dispatch to wallet.

evidenceRequirements.title: Citizen identity
evidenceRequirements.description: Identity evidence for the applicant.

evidenceRequirements.title: Eligibility evidence
evidenceRequirements.description: Proof of eligibility for the empowerment fund.

evidenceRequirements.title: Verifiable credential proof
evidenceRequirements.description: Credential proof from the citizen wallet app.

stages.title: Intake
stages.description: Check mortgage pack completeness.

stages.title: Valuation Review

stages.title: Approval
stages.description: Approve mortgage and dispatch to wallet.

evidenceRequirements.title: Income proof

evidenceRequirements.title: Valuation report

evidenceRequirements.title: Verifiable credential proof
